title: matching.link.confirmed
description: An operator (or the deterministic GTIN pass) confirmed a SupplierProduct -> CanonicalProduct link. Topic: sa.matching.link, key: supplier_product_id.

method.description: How the candidate was produced. gtin_auto links are auto-confirmed; others require an operator.

decided_by.description: Operator user id, or 'system' for gtin_auto

previous_canonical_product_id.description: Set when the confirmation re-links the product from another canonical (merge/split flows)
